scripts.build:sdk: npm run verify:vendor && tsc -p vendor/devkit/packages/local/tsconfig.json && node vendor/devkit/scripts/copy-package-notices.mjs vendor/devkit/packages/local/dist
scripts.build: npm run build:sdk && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node ../../scripts/build.mjs helper
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:sdk && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.native.json
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit
